page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7se.8xlarge is a compute-optimized instance within the Enhanced family, driven by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The virtual machine allocates 32 vCPUs across 16 physical cores utilizing two threads per core under the KVM hypervisor. Hardware features include 48 MB of Level 3 cache, dedicated execution resources, and hardware support for cryptographic acceleration via AES and SHA-NI, alongside advanced vector computation instructions including AVX-512 and AVX-512 VNNI.

The instance delivers 64.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio of 2.0 GB per thread. Network capacity provides a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps. It contains no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage solutions for all persistence requirements, and does not include discrete GPU hardware accelerators. Benchmark evaluations position the instance within the middle tier for compute density, posting a PassMark CPU score of 36,838.07 and a Geekbench multi-core rating of 13,470.0. Memory throughput demonstrates notable strength, achieving a PassMark memory score of 2,789.6 and uncached large-block read bandwidth of 155.72 GB/sec.

From an architectural standpoint, the 1:2 resource ratio maintains cost efficiency by avoiding stranded memory capacity when supporting compute-heavy tasks. In workload-specific benchmarks, the platform generated 31.36 million Redis SET operations per second and handled 33.55 GB/sec of static web serving throughput. It also demonstrated high execution efficiency in lightweight machine learning inference, registering 316.66 tokens per second in 135M model text generation tests. The ecs.c7se.8xlarge is engineered for compute-intensive workloads such as multi-threaded software compilation, batch processing, data compression pipelines, and distributed web serving.
